attachments.name: Blockchain in Education
attachments.description: Among the many innovations in the field of technology, blockchain is an especially promising one. Its goal to achieve widespread adoption has yet to be reached, but that is not stopping its impact and prominent presence. Since Bitcoin’s 2009 inception, blockchain is seen as a catalyst for change in regards to various industries. Moreover, blockchain in education has the potential to disrupt the education sector.
